attributes.name: Secret Broker
attributes.powers:
On a character at your location's check to acquire a boon that has the Magic trait, recharge this card to add 2d12.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, you may recharge a card to add a die to any check that invokes a trait on the recharged card.
